title: StableRonaldo Yells “Learn How to Drive” and Instantly Regrets It
caption: Ronaldo yells “learn how to drive” and immediately gives everyone a reason to say it back. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: I swear the car only goes rogue after I criticize somebody else's driving.
why: The driving insult opens the clip, then Ronaldo undercuts his entire rant by admitting he sucks at driving.
